overview.Module Title: HR Digital Transformation and Implementation Strategy

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module examines what digital transformation in human resources (HR) means, what it entails, and the challenges organisations face in enabling it. It prepares students to lead and participate in HR digital transformation implementation, and to adopt AI-empowered HR solutions where appropriate in a context-sensitive and evidence-based manner. By studying this module, students will understand the benefits of HR digital transformation and the latest technologies applied to management practice, such as AI, machine learning and people analytics. Students will explore how to develop and implement data-driven and AI-empowered HR strategies for both established organisations and entrepreneurial firms, gaining a deep understanding of how to initiate, execute and sustain critical HR digital transformation projects.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Demonstrate a critical understanding of how to utilise data analytics, including data sources and collection methods, as well as a range of HR technologies (conventional, AI-empowered and other emerging technologies), to support digital HR transformation and make informed talent and business decisions. B. Critically evaluate representative approaches to identifying and solving business challenges related to digital HRM in various organisational contexts. C. Apply and evaluate selected emerging tools to support the digital transformation of HR practices at organisational, functional and individual levels.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: In line with the philosophy of Syntegrative Education, this module adopts an intensive block-teaching format that supports industry engagement and problem-based, project-oriented assessment. The module is delivered through a series of key lectures and seminars. It provides in-depth overviews of the key trends, issues and methods involved in the strategic implementation of digital HR. Drawing on real-world case studies and recent research, students explore effective digital HR adoption strategies and develop the technological capabilities needed to enhance employee management and productivity.
